title: Down Tools
text: {who} speaks for the strikers: shorter shifts, or no shifts at all.

choices.label: Shorter hours
choices.reply: Work hours go to short. {who} shakes a drone's manipulator, which is a first.

choices.label: Hold firm
choices.reply: The hours stay. The strikers stay out. Some of the Devoted cover their shifts.

choices.label: Double rations for a week
choices.reply: A feast, then a week of full plates. It isn't what they asked for, but people eat.
